subject: Hardware-accelerated inference: developer webinar nurture roadmap & tracking
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hardware-accelerated inference: developer webinar nurture roadmap & tracking

Hi team,

We have confirmation for the developer-focused webinar on hardware-accelerated inference (Aug 10). Goal: drive engineer RSVPs and get platform/procurement stakeholders into post-webinar meetings. I sketched an initial nurture roadmap and attached audience_segments.csv + timeline_v1.xlsx.

Asks:
- Can you draft 3 subject-line variants and two body-length variants (short + expanded) focused on: engineer curiosity, platform performance, procurement ROI?
- I want a segmentation key in the tracking links: seg=eng|infra|proc and source=webinar_inbound. Use UTM params in the URLs so we can compare CTR by segment.
- Reminder cadence: propose an automated 3-touch sequence (7 days, 2 days, 1 day) + a live reminder 1 hour before. Also propose an AB test for the 2-day reminder (time-of-day).
- Include a small follow-up path for no-shows with on-demand recording + CTA for a 20-min technical deep-dive.

Constraints and notes:
- Keep send windows to PST-friendly mornings for US-east/US-west engineers (08:00-11:00 PST) or early afternoons for EMEA.
- We need a HubSpot tracking ID on each RSVP link and a separate calendar add link for those who register.

I want a draft copy and a final-ready send plan by Friday EOD.

Thanks,
Connor
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: audience_segments.csv (CSV), timeline_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-26T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hardware-accelerated inference: developer webinar nurture roadmap & tracking

Connor,

Love this brief — good constraints. Draft copy and tracking plan attached (email_variants.docx). Highlights below.

Subject-line variants (engineer-focused):
- "How to shave 50% off inference latency with hardware tricks"
- "Practical GPU optimizations for LLM serving — Aug 10"
- "Hands-on: speed and cost wins for inference teams"

Short body (for 1-day reminder):
Hi {{first_name}},
Join our short, engineer-led session on Aug 10 to see production patterns for hardware-accelerated LLM inference. We’ll cover kernel selection, KV-caching strategies, and real perf numbers. Register + add to calendar: https://redwood.ai/webinars/hw-accel?utm_source=webinar_inbound&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hw_accel_2027&seg=eng&utm_term={{hubspot_id}}

Expanded body (initial invite): includes bullets on agenda, speakers (runtime/ops), and a 10-min Q&A + optional 20-min deep-dive qualification meeting.

Tracking plan: use hubspot parameter hs_id, utm_campaign=hw_accel_2027, seg tags (eng|infra|proc), and &variant=A/B for subject-line tests. Create a separate calendar-add link with &cal=1 that bypasses our RSVP flow for users who prefer calendar-only adds.

Reminder cadence (proposed):
- Initial invite (T - 14) — long copy, agenda, speakers
- Reminder 1 (T - 7) — short, focus on immediate value + calendar add
- Reminder 2 (T - 2) — AB test subject (AM vs PM)
- Reminder 3 (T - 1) — 1-line: "Webinar tomorrow — add to calendar" + 1-hour pre-send 

Segmentation suggestion: pipeline status + persona + event attendance source. For conference leads, add &src=conf.<confcode>.

I added copy variants tailored to procurement (cost/ROI) and platform (scaling, autoscaling policies) in the attachment.

Marissa
Director, Demand Gen
Redwood Inference

Attachment: email_variants.docx (docx)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-28T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hardware-accelerated inference: developer webinar nurture roadmap & tracking

Thanks — a few operational notes from ops/deliverability: 

- Send windows: test two cohorts for the 2-day reminder: cohort A (09:00 PST) and cohort B (14:00 PST). Use 10% sample each to measure open and CTR; roll the winner to the remaining 80%.
- For the 7-day invite, send in two waves to reduce spike load on the RSVP endpoint (wave 1: 08:30 PST, wave 2: 10:00 PST).
- Add a suppression for any contact who has marked "no promotional email" in the past 180 days.
- For no-show path: within 24 hours send recording + CTA to book a 20-min infra sync. Use a separate tracking param &noshow=1 to measure conversion.

Also: verify the calendar add link can accept &cal=1 and still append the hubspot tracking. If not, we'll create two distinct landing pages: one for RSVP (preferred) + calendar add success redirect.

I'll prepare the send windows and the sample-size calculation spreadsheet tomorrow and fold that into Final_send_plan.xlsx.

Tessa
Growth Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Sylvia —

Great to hear you and the team are joining. Short answers: yes and yes.

Content: we will include a 10-minute section on dedicated capacity vs hosted fallback patterns and a 5-minute overview of quantization trade-offs (8-bit vs 4-bit) with real-world throughput/latency numbers drawn from our benchmark suite. For the deep-dive we’ll offer a post-webinar 20-minute technical sync.

Procurement: we can accept PO info for follow-up. For sales/finance coordination I’ll send a short DocuSign/PO intake after the webinar. In the meantime, you can share a billing contact directly or use this DocuSign intake room: https://docusign.example.com/rooms/REDWOOD-WEB-789

Final send plan attached. Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=hw-accel-webinar-2027-08-10. HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example.com/contacts/12345.

Thanks — see you on Aug 10, and if you want to pre-schedule the 20-min sync drop a time and we’ll book it.

Connor
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
